title: Crickets (Awkward Silence)
blurb: A joke lands in an empty field, and nature declines to comment. Crickets are the most elegant way ever devised to certify a flop, largely because they do not mock — they simply continue, indifferent, while a punchline dies in front of witnesses. It works for an unanswered question, a group chat that read the message and moved on, and a pun delivered with real confidence into total stillness. Deploy generously, because somebody always deserves it, and be aware that the person who deserves it is occasionally you.
origin: The classic cricket chirp of comedic silence.
